meta.name: Dating Disasters
meta.description:
Finding love is hard, and keeping that love alive is even harder! Don’t miss a single date, shouting match or tossed wine glass from TV’s best reality shows, 24 hours a day.

Shows: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny, Flavor of Love: Reindeer Games, Flavor of Love: Things That Go Bump On The Lip, Flavor of Love: The Lyin The Witch  And The Wardrobe Malfunction, Flavor of Love: Dial M For Mystery Pimp Caller?
Available on: Pluto TV
